content.text: That fixed it — completing the remaining work orders.

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H2","instruction_en":"Tape an A4 sheet upright on the door frame in the walkthrough and take a new photo to measure the threshold height.","instruction_zh":"請在門框直立貼一張A4紙，重新拍照以量測門檻高度。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H3","instruction_en":"Remove or fix flat the red patterned rug against the wall in the walkthrough and clear the cords from it.","instruction_zh":"請將靠牆紅色花紋地毯移走或貼平固定，並移開上方電線。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H4","instruction_en":"Move the black cable with connector on the rolled rug near the doorway in the walkthrough off the walking path.","instruction_zh":"請將門口捲起地毯上的黑色連接線移離走道收好。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H5","instruction_en":"Move the black cable across the tiled hallway floor in the walkthrough off the walking path and route it along the edge.","instruction_zh":"請將磁磚走道上橫跨地面的黑色電線移離走道，沿邊收好。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H6","instruction_en":"Put the light-colored sneakers on the tiled floor in the walkthrough into the shoe cabinet.","instruction_zh":"請將磁磚地面上的淺色球鞋收到鞋櫃。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H7","instruction_en":"Put the light-colored shoes on the wood floor in the walkthrough into the shoe cabinet.","instruction_zh":"請將木地板上的淺色鞋子收到鞋櫃。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H8","instruction_en":"Put the dark blue open-toe slippers on the tiled floor in the walkthrough into the shoe cabinet.","instruction_zh":"請將磁磚地面上的深藍色露趾拖鞋收到鞋櫃。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H9","instruction_en":"Put the dark blue slide slippers on the tiled floor in the walkthrough into the shoe cabinet.","instruction_zh":"請將磁磚地面上的深藍色平底拖鞋收到鞋櫃。"}
